dex.entry: A round-eared ice-bear cub of the Pale Vault Glacier whose fur is threaded with prism-crystal filaments; it tumbles through snowdrifts leaving miniature rainbow trails in its wake. A glittery rainbow bear cub — the purest concentrated 'kids will love this' design in the batch.

art.silhouette: Chubby bear cub with snow-white fur laced with fine crystal-threads that catch light in rainbow refractions; a big round nose; small triangular ears; wide trusting eyes; stumbles more than walks; irresistibly cute at 16px.
